acquisition_method.evidence: MS/MS peptide sequencing was performed using a Top15 DDA scan strategy with HCD at 30% NCE, to be detected in the Orbitrap with a resolution of 30000.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Proteins were in-gel digested with trypsin and desalted as described in https://doi.org/10.1021/pr500164j.

collision_energy.evidence: MS/MS peptide sequencing was performed using a Top15 DDA scan strategy with HCD at 30% NCE, to be detected in the Orbitrap with a resolution of 30000.

enrichment_method.evidence: the supernatant was subjected to ADPr-enrichment with the enhanced Af1521 Macro domain (https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-020-18981-w).

fractionation_method.evidence: Protein samples were separated by 12% SDS-PAGE until the running front had migrated 1 cm into the separating gel.

fragmentation_method.evidence: MS/MS peptide sequencing was performed using a Top15 DDA scan strategy with HCD at 30% NCE, to be detected in the Orbitrap with a resolution of 30000.

instrument.evidence: Peptides were analyzed on a Fusion Lumos Tribrid mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific).

ionization_type.evidence: Eluted peptides were electrosprayed on-line into the Fusion Lumos Tribrid with a spray voltage of 2.0 kV and capillary temperature of 305°C.

ptm.evidence: Carbamidomethylation of cysteine (C) was set as fixed modification.

Variable modifications were oxidation of methionine (M), acetylated protein N-termini and ADP-ribosylation of aspartic acid (D), glutamic acid (E), asparagine (N), lysine (K), arginine (R), serine (S), cysteine (C), and histidine (H).
